scope.geometry: Evaluate one analytic point on a decoded ellipse-curve representation
scope.parameterization: Radians; center + projectedMajorAxis*cos(t) + rightHandedMinorAxis*(ratio*majorRadius)*sin(t), where rightHandedMinorAxis follows normalizedNormal cross majorAxis
scope.frame_policy: Normalize a temporary normal, validate the relative normal component of the major axis against a finite nonnegative caller-supplied dimensionless tolerance, and remove only a tolerated discrepancy before evaluation
scope.numeric_policy: Scale normal and major-axis vectors before normalization; exponent-safe products and scaled coordinate sums avoid unnecessary intermediate overflow and preserve representable large-coordinate cancellation
scope.refusal_policy: Unsupported curve type, invalid/nonfinite input, zero normal/axis/projected axis, frame residual above caller tolerance, invalid ratio, or unrepresentable output returns false without modifying the output point
scope.semantic_limit: The API explicitly defines a right-handed utility parameterization; the inspected peer docs corroborate field labels and ratio meaning only, not native ACIS/SAB parameter direction or kernel semantics
non_claims: finite edge endpoint interval or trim evaluation
native consumer or independent-kernel semantic qualification
